name: file_bin
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production Funke editor file icon, smooth raster master.
Primary request: Generate ONE new slate blue folded-document icon in precisely the visual family of the two supplied reference images.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved green C# icon, image 2 is the approved grey TXT icon; both are STYLE AND PROPORTION REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets. Match their thick upright rounded rectangular paper silhouette, upper-right folded triangular corner, frontal camera, soft bevels, satin surface, material thickness, warm ivory raised glyph material and soft upper-left lighting.
Subject: one slate blue folded document with large raised warm ivory 01 glyph. Exactly two large bold rounded sans-serif numerals, zero on the left and one on the right. The zero has a clear open counter and no slash, and one is a simple clearly readable number.
Text (verbatim): "01". No other text or marks.
Composition/framing: square canvas about 1024 by 1024, single centered front-facing document, height exactly about 87.5 percent of canvas, equal top and bottom margins, same document aspect ratio and fold proportions as the references. Glyph below the folded corner, optically centered on the remaining main face, bold and large like the reference C# glyph, easily recognizable at a tiny 16 pixel display size.
Style/medium: refined soft beveled satin 3D app icon; smoothly rendered, not pixel art. Consistent modest extrusion on the ivory glyph, rounded bevels, localized contact shadows only on the document surface.
Color palette: slate blue body with lighter same-hue folded corner; ivory glyph.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, fully isolated. No floor, ground or background and no external cast shadow.
Constraints: clean smooth exterior alpha edge with no detached flecks; all shadows confined to the silhouette. No checkerboard painted into the image. No added lines, badges, small text, border, watermark, extra objects or multiple icons. Preserve the reference family proportions and silhouette.
